# Alem

> The Economic Control Plane for AI Agents. Alem develops identity, delegated authority, policy controls, approvals, ledgers and outcome measurement for AI agents.

## Products
- Alem Finance: https://finance.askalem.com/ — invoice intake, finance operations, approval workflows and AI-assisted document review. Workspace: https://app.finance.askalem.com/.
- Alem ROI & Agent Gateway: https://beta.askalem.com/ — agent registration, budgets, policy checks, human approvals, ledger and cost/outcome tracking; private-beta sandbox. No real payment settlement is live.

## Company
Alem is operated by AQYL.AI PTE. LTD. Backed by Antler.
Founder: Dinara Abdizhaparova. Email: dinara@askalem.com.
Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/askalemcom/
Company X: https://x.com/askalemai

## Important limitations
Finance accounting connectors are being validated in pilots. ROI settlement and live card, bank and stablecoin payment execution are not yet enabled.
